title: Create a carousel from a brief
description: Turns a brief or a pasted post into a deck, saves it as a draft and renders the slides and a PDF with the brand kit. Input: brief or sourceText, optional slides, size (portrait, square, story), render (default true). Never publishes.
phrases: create a carousel from this post
build a linkedin carousel from this brief

safety.rule: Creates local files only. Never publishes.
safety.notes: Sends the brief to a model provider only when a model key is set in the environment; with no key the built-in fallback drafts locally.
